about_the_game:
Fuse Pokémon-style creatures with Hearthstone-inspired combat in this fast, strategic card battler. Build 30-card elemental decks, level your cards mid-match, and climb the ranked ladder through Solo quests, PvP duels, automated tournaments, and seasonal events.

About This Game

Fracctal TCG distills the thrill of monster collecting into a one-versus-one card game built for quick, tactical showdowns.

  • Eight elemental teams. Fire melts Ice, Plant poisons Rock, Electric blitzes Water—master unique synergies or splash multiple elements for surprise tech.

  • Hearthstone-like resource curve. Both players start at 2 mana and gain +1 per turn (max 10), keeping matches brisk without runaway snowballing.

  • 30-card decks, 20 HP heroes. Every draw matters; teched counters and tempo swings decide the match in under ten minutes.

  • Card evolution. Let a creature survive three of your turns and it morphs into a stronger form—protect it or pay the price.

  • Hero powers (Fairy skills). Fire blasts 2 damage, Plant heals, Rock builds armor, Psychic puts foes to sleep, and more—one use per turn, so timing is everything.

  • Level-up progression. Win games, complete daily quests, and earn currency to enhance your favorite cards or unlock fresh archetypes.

  • Solo & PvP content.

    • Tutorial Mode that teaches core mechanics.

    • Practice and level up your skills in Solo Mode.

    • Ranked PvP Ladder with seasonal resets and cosmetic rewards.

  • Automated & Custom Tournaments

    Compete in daily or weekly automated tournaments for in-game currency, rare cards, or cosmetic rewards. Or host your own custom tournaments with player-defined rules and prizes—perfect for streamers, guilds, or community events. Bracketed matchmaking and prize distribution handled seamlessly by our backend.

Whether you love crunchy card math or flashy creature battles, Fracctal TCG offers depth for veterans and an inviting tutorial for newcomers.

Key Features

  • Element-based deck-building (8 teams, hundreds of cards)

  • Evolving minions that transform mid-battle

  • Hero power system—eight play-styles right out of the box

  • Tutorial, Solo, Ranked, and Custom play modes

  • Daily & weekly challenges with generous progression

  • Seasonal expansions that add new mechanics without power-creep

  • Cross-platform with iOS, macOS, Android, and PC

reviews:
“Recommended. A free-to-play one-on-one trading card game built for quick, tactical showdowns. Collect creatures, customize your deck, and engage in cross-platform multiplayer battles. A tough strategic card game.”
The Enormous Room

“Fracctal TCG is a welcome addition to the digital card game landscape. The development team has demonstrated an impressive level of polish. The gameplay experience is fluid, even in its testing phase. It feels as complete and functional as its more established competitors.”
7.5/10 – Somos Gaming
